assets.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: production EMPTY ground-only stage for an interactive 2D medieval castle-town strategy game. The entire central 80 percent must be a spacious, mostly flat, naturally continuous buildable stone/earth meadow stage. No buildings anywhere, including tiny background silhouettes. Keep ONLY the reference's crisp realistic hand-painted limestone/cobblestone, oak/olive natural palette, soft upper-left daylight, pine edge vegetation and a quiet distant ridge; grass is subdued sage green, stones are cool gray, no yellow-brown filter. Fixed elevated orthographic three-quarter 35-degree camera for sprites that will be overlaid later; DO NOT draw a horizon or a photographic foreground, maintain consistent scale across the usable stage. At upper-middle (x50 percent,y40 percent) make one unobtrusive EMPTY broad gray stone royal-terrace base with natural irregular edges and NO building on it, connecting to a legible gently bending main cobblestone road through the center toward lower-middle. A few narrow organically bending branch lanes lead into broad irregular empty plots, not a regular grid. No ravines, lakes or cliffs inside the central buildable 80 percent. Quiet trees/rocks only at the OUTER margins, keep the actual playable interior visually calm. Wide landscape production stage; sharp macro shapes with restrained non-repeating surface detail. No text, labels, icons, UI, squares, outlines, patterned platform tiles, watermarks or baked functional objects. This is the final empty stage, not a concept art of a populated town.
